CzernyScope Windows x64
Qt 6.11.2 third-party component notices
=====================================

The files below accompany the Qt Base, Qt SVG and Qt Image Formats
libraries and plugins in the Windows package. These records identify
open-source material in the matching Qt source. Some components are
optional Qt build features and their presence in a particular DLL
depends on the upstream wheel build configuration.

CzernyScope uses Qt Core, Gui, Network, Widgets, SVG and the Windows and
image format plugins. The scope of this set is the source-level
attribution for those Qt modules and the corresponding Windows plugins.
The Qt/PySide LGPL and GPL terms are provided separately in the main
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt and its accompanying licenses. The matching
source archives remain the authoritative copy of the component notices.

License files and the Qt attribution JSON records have been preserved
with their original bytes. The manifest maps files to the source
archives and records their SHA-256 checksums. Entries below are in Qt
module order. Paths are relative to this notice folder.
